Optional (nominal) copays for some groups, for example 1931 families, SSI and Freedom to Work: $2.30 prescription, $2.30 outpatient therapy, $3.40 office visit; a provider cannot deny care for nonpayment. Required copays for Transitional Medical Assistance adults: $2.30 prescription, $4.00 office visit, $3.00 therapy, $3.00 non-emergency outpatient surgery. Total capped at 5% of household income per quarter. Exempt: under 19, SMI, ALTCS, hospice, AI/AN, pregnant and postpartum members, and others; exempt services include hospital stays, ER, family planning, pregnancy and preventive care.
